QUOTE: `allow` is checked only in `check_approval`. Neither list is checked in the other place.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says allow is consulted only in check_approval (tool_executor.cpp) while deny is in ServerManager::execute (a different file). It also shows allow only sets auto_ok, which skips the approval step and is not an execution grant, since deny still blocks at execute.
